auditor: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), one call per section, reasoning_effort low
scope: compiled facts vs the handbook pages they cite (card backs are byte copies of these facts); exam items and lesson narration not checked in this pass

flagged.issue: Page states only general warning and does not mention slowing down and staying alert.
Page states the octagon controls an intersection but does not state the triangle controls intersections.
flagged.suggested_fix: The octagon demands a full stop at a controlled intersection and the triangle means yield the right of way.

flagged.issue: Page does not describe the pennant as a sideways triangle or the diamond as four-sided.
flagged.suggested_fix: The pennant is on the left marking a no-passing zone, while the diamond warns of special road hazards.

flagged.issue: The page states the stop and yield rules but never uses or describes a two-point visibility maneuver.
flagged.suggested_fix: The stop sign demands a full stop until crossing traffic clears, stopping at the stop line if present, while the yield sign requires slowing and yielding the right of way.

flagged.issue: Omits the page's exceptions for officer/signal direction and EXEMPT signs.
flagged.suggested_fix: Buses, hired rides, and hazmat haulers must stop 15 to 50 feet before the rails unless directed to proceed or the crossing is marked EXEMPT.

flagged.issue: Page lists them as conveyances with pedestrian rights but does not state they are not vehicles.
flagged.suggested_fix: Skateboards and scooters are listed as pedestrian conveyances covered by the pedestrian term.

flagged.issue: Omits the third sign type, “Yield Here to Pedestrians and Bicycles,” listed on the page.
flagged.suggested_fix: Yield lines mark where to yield for “Yield,” “Yield Here To Pedestrians,” or “Yield Here to Pedestrians and Bicycles” signs.

flagged.issue: Omits the unless-instructed exception for the shoulder and overstates the left lane as exclusively for passing when page says generally.
flagged.suggested_fix: Unless instructed by a device or official, never drive or pass on the shoulder; the left lane is generally used for passing.

flagged.issue: Page says suspension is for up to one year, not a mandatory full year.
flagged.suggested_fix: The slowdown sets no number, only reasonable and proper, while the penalty allows suspension for up to one year.

flagged.issue: Hands-free is not voice-only for all uses because video streaming/calls are banned even with voice commands.
flagged.suggested_fix: Hands-free generally requires no holding or manual interaction and voice activation for calls, but video streaming/calls remain banned even with voice commands.

flagged.issue: The page says the 4- to 5-second rule applies at 40 mph, not past 40 mph.
flagged.suggested_fix: At speeds of 40 mph a 4- to 5-second following distance is recommended, and 6 or more seconds when slippery or view-blocked.

flagged.issue: The page specifies four- to five-seconds at 40 mph and six-plus when slippery/view-blocked, not five or six-plus generally.
flagged.suggested_fix: At speeds of 40 mph use four- to five-seconds, and six or more seconds when slippery or view-blocked, and with ABS press hard and hold.

flagged.issue: The statement omits the page's day/night, surfaced/unsurfaced, and truck qualifiers for the 50 and 60 mph limits.
flagged.suggested_fix: 50 mph on unsurfaced secondaries sunset-sunrise and for all trucks on secondaries anytime; 60 mph on primaries, urban interstates, and secondaries including unpaved sunrise-sunset; 70 mph rural interstates.

flagged.issue: The page requires checking the far lane for same-gap mergers but does not state that near checks miss them.
flagged.suggested_fix: Check the far lane, if there is one, as someone in that lane may be planning to move into the same lane you want to enter.

flagged.issue: Omits that sign is only possible (may) and omits flashing-lights alternative.
flagged.suggested_fix: Slow rigs may display a slow-moving sign (an orange triangle or flashing lights), so spot early and slow safely.

flagged.issue: Page says almost half of deaths are in vehicles, not most, and 6 inches sweeps SUVs/pickups.
flagged.suggested_fix: Almost half of flash-flood deaths happen in vehicles, and as little as 6 inches may sweep away a vehicle including SUVs and pickups.

flagged.issue: Page says be prepared to stop, not that bridges demand full stops.
flagged.suggested_fix: Gravel oncoming hugs right through dust, while narrow one-vehicle bridges require being prepared to stop.

flagged.issue: Omits the less-than-10-minutes time limit and mild-day 100-degree detail.
flagged.suggested_fix: Parked cabins can soar above 160 degrees in less than 10 minutes, and Iowa law allows breaking glass to rescue trapped persons/animals.

flagged.issue: The page supports hands on wheel and staying calm but does not state anything about arguing during stops.
flagged.suggested_fix: Keep hands visible on the steering wheel, remain calm, and follow the officer's instructions.
